runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Lemon-Caper Chicken Piccata, Khinkali, Honey-Roasted Quince
runs.content:
1. Lemon-Caper Chicken Piccata with Green Beans — inspired by Lucinda Scala Quinn. A 30-minute weeknight fix built around mastering one useful pan-sauce technique (deglaze, reduce, mount with butter).
2. Khinkali (Georgian Soup Dumplings) — inspired by Anthony Bourdain. A medium-technique weekend project — Georgia's broth-filled dumplings, discovered on Parts Unknown, in the same spirit as the Filipino adobo and Sichuan dan dan already in the collection.
3. Honey-Roasted Quince with Cardamom, Bay and Cream — inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: the first proper quince of early autumn, given nothing but time in a slow oven.

runs.summary: 3 new recipes: Nasi Goreng, Fuku-Style Nashville Hot Fried Chicken Sandwich, Wild Mushrooms on Toast
runs.content:
1. Nasi Goreng (Indonesian Fried Rice) — inspired by Anthony Bourdain. A 25-minute weeknight fix built on cold rice, kecap manis, and shrimp paste — the Indonesian dish he championed on A Cook's Tour and Parts Unknown.
2. Fuku-Style Nashville Hot Fried Chicken Sandwich — inspired by David Chang. A medium-technique project built on Chang's Fuku fast-casual format — buttermilk brine, double dredge, hot oil finish, gochujang mayo.
3. Wild Mushrooms on Toast with Thyme and Cream — inspired by Nigel Slater. The wild card: the first wild mushrooms of early autumn, treated with almost nothing but butter, garlic, and cream.
